wholePhysicalScope: Native footprint with connected monastery houses, first-person public-domain photography, the published Qualla images and official municipal and national architectural records.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the concave western front, paired bell towers and hexagonal dome.
limitations: Lower wing elevations and hipped roof subdivisions, the restoration-era dome weathering, individual carvings and ornaments are proportional interpretations. The church interior, detached hermit cells, entrance gate and the separate eastern bell tower are outside the connected-building scope.
